description: This file contains utility functions for pinning tensors and data structures into pinned memory for efficient data loading in PyTorch, including a background thread loop for pinning tensors in a multiprocessing context.

methods.name: _pin_memory_loop
methods.description: Background thread loop for pinning data into memory and putting it into an output queue.

methods.name: pin_memory
methods.description: Function to recursively pin various data structures into pinned memory for efficient GPU transfer.
